title: pvPointAndCellIds
body:
## pvPointAndCellIds

Adds integer arrays with each point's zero-based index (PointIds, point data) and each cell's index (CellIds, cell data) as numbered in this dataset; hyper tree grid input gets cell ids only. The arrays travel with points and cells through later extraction, so they can trace results back to the original elements. generateIds is the curated alternative.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Ids are local: each block of composite data and each MPI process numbers its own piece; use pvGlobalPointAndCellIds for ids unique across blocks and processes.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `PointAndCellIds`. Identity: `filters/PointAndCellIds`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Cell Data to Point Data filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
